=== Wade Noelke Attachment A Correction.docx ===
NF5 Family Limited Partnership, Intervenor in 59182 and 59475
SOAH DOCKET NO. 473-26–16349
PUC DOCKET NO. 59475

INTERVENOR NF5 FAMILY LIMITED PARTNERSHIP’S CORRECTION TO ATTACHMENT A IN SOAH ORDER NO. 30
TO THE HONORABLE ADMINISTRATIVE LAW JUDGES:
Pursuant to the SOAH Prehearing Conference and SOAH Order No. 30 in 59475, COMES NOW, Wade Noelke, on behalf of NF5 Family Limited Partnership (“NF5”), to submit his notice that he intends to correct Exhibit A in SOAH Order No. 30 by adding the following evidentiary exhibit for NF5: “Exhibit 1: Wade Noelke’s Direct Testimony on Behalf of NF5 Family Limited Partnership.” 
NF5 timely submitted its “NF5 Family Limited Partnership Direct Testimony by Wade Noelke” on the Public Utilities Commission Interchange on May 13th, 2026 (item #3973). Further, NF5 timely submitted its “NF5 FAMILY LIMITED PARTNERSHIP'S EXHIBIT LIST AND DESIGNATION OF WITNESSES” pleading on the Public Utilities Commission Interchange on June 3rd, 2026 (item #5564). NF5 then submitted the same “NF5 FAMILY LIMITED PARTNERSHIP'S EXHIBIT LIST AND DESIGNATION OF WITNESSES” on the Kiteworks and Egnyte platforms before the SOAH Prehearing Conference on June 5th, 2026.
During the Prehearing Conference, the honorable Judge Brite seemed to approve of Wade Noelke’s request to add his “Exhibit 1: Wade Noelke’s Direct Testimony on Behalf of NF5 Family Limited Partnership” to Attachment A on SOAH Order No. 30. Further, Oncor’s counsel stated it had no objection to Wade Noelke’s request to add his direct testimony to the Kiteworks and Egnyte platforms.
Therefore, NF5 requests the honorable Administrative Law Judges admit NF5’s “Exhibit 1: Wade Noelke’s Direct Testimony on Behalf of NF5 Family Limited Partnership” to Attachment A of SOAH Order No. 30, which allows NF5’s critical direct testimony exhibit to be submitted as a pre-hearing submission for the evidentiary record.

Signed June 5, 2026
Respectfully submitted,
/s/ Wade Noelke
Wade Noelke
NF5 Family Limited Partnership
Intervenor

CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE
I certify that a true and correct copy of the foregoing document was served on all parties and counsel of record on June 5, 2026 with PUC Procedural Rule 22.74 and Orders issued in Docket No. 59182 and 59475.
/s/Wade Noelke
Wade Noelke
